text:
Man is love. Man is a beam, a center

where the world is knotted. If Man fails,

again come the void and the battle

of first chaos and the God who cries, "I enter!"


Man is love, and God lives within

that deep chest, and there falls silent;

with those eyes he peers, beyond the fence,

at his creation, astonished by encounter.


I, Love-Man, govern the total system

(my Universe). Oh God, do not annihilate me,

you immense flower growing in my insomnia!


I am your center for you, your theme

of deep rumination, your dwelling and your hanging gardens.

If I come undone, you disappear.

translation.title: Man Is Love. Man Is a Beam, a Center...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Alonso's daring mutual dependence between human consciousness and God.
